title: Goal B interface-library decisions
summary: Accepted bounded decisions for Goal B after independent Goal A acceptance.

decisions.decision: Design Atlas is a deterministic projection of accepted registries, never an independent handwritten registry.
decisions.reason: Runtime, docs, CLI and MCP must not drift.

decisions.decision: Ownership and authoring_kind are independent Atlas facets; fence length never determines type.
decisions.reason: Provider ownership and Markdown syntax are separate contracts.

decisions.decision: Every container publishes finite children, slots, count, order and maximum-depth rules.
decisions.reason: Nesting must fail closed before rendering.

decisions.decision: Search, breadcrumbs and pager become registered Docara leaves while page/head stay application-owned.
decisions.reason: Only replaceable chrome belongs in the interface library.

decisions.decision: Framework components are supported only from exact independently accepted owner artifacts.
decisions.reason: Docara must not invent or fork Framework controls.
